# OC International Holding Sdn. Bhd.

> OC International Holding Sdn. Bhd. ("OC International", "OCIH", https://ocih.group) is the parent company of a growing group of businesses. Its first group company is OC Global Technology Sdn. Bhd. (OCGT), a Malaysian technology company headquartered in Johor Bahru that powers digital growth through conversation, commerce and community platforms.

## Group structure

- Parent company: OC International Holding Sdn. Bhd.
- Subsidiary: OC Global Technology Sdn. Bhd. (OCGT), https://www.ocglobaltech.com
- OCGT is a Malaysia Digital (MD) status company recognised by MDEC.
- OCGT builds four platforms: O'ZONE, O'CARE, O'CHAT and O'SMASH.

## Platforms by OC Global Technology

- O'ZONE (Create. Share. Earn.): a video platform combining content sharing, an AI-powered creation studio and a transparent earning model where creators receive half of net ad revenue based on real engagement.
- O'CARE (Care. Connect. Protect.): unified school communication and emotional well-being, with dual chat modes, real-time insights and SOS alerts.
- O'CHAT (Private. Secure. Yours.): private messaging with end-to-end encrypted text, voice and video, phone-number sign-up and encrypted backups.
- O'SMASH (Train. Track. Win.): coaching management for badminton coaches and academies, covering players, sessions, attendance and payments.
